result.rationale: Research confirmed a November 2021 UBS Asset Management acquisition of a five-project ERCOT battery portfolio through its infrastructure/real-assets business, but the exact continuing manager-level legal boundary and current legal ownership of each original project could not be established from the completed evidence. Later public disclosures reference UBS-managed ERCOT portfolios of different sizes (including later 400 MW and ~730 MW portfolios), preventing a reliable one-to-one mapping of the original five assets.

identityResolution.canonicalIdentity: Proposed manager-level portfolio: UBS ERCOT Battery Storage Portfolio (2021)
aliases: Black Mountain Energy Storage five-project portfolio

operatingResolution.boundaryConclusion: Do not separately count underlying SPVs if the common portfolio is ultimately confirmed; however the original five-project composition and continuing common ownership platform remain unproven.
operatingResolution.projectIdentity: Original acquisition covered five standalone ERCOT battery projects, but the completed research could not conclusively reconcile all original project/SPV names with later disclosed portfolios.

acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatus: No completed exit of the original 2021 portfolio was proven, but neither was uninterrupted UBS ownership of the original five-project portfolio through 2026.

milestones.event: UBS Asset Management announced acquisition of a five-project ERCOT battery storage portfolio.
Separate UBS-related ERCOT battery transaction announced involving 400 MW portfolio, indicating later portfolio activity rather than proving continuity with the 2021 assets.
Habitat Energy announced optimization of a UBS Asset Management ~730 MW ERCOT battery portfolio, but direct mapping to the original five projects remained unverified.

evidence.label: UBS Asset Management energy-storage case study
evidence.purpose: Direct UBS evidence of the 2021 ERCOT acquisition and the later six-project, 930 MW portfolio boundary

beforeAfterChanges.before: Proposed new portfolio based on 2021 acquisition alone.
beforeAfterChanges.after: Creation should be deferred until the original five-project legal boundary and current UBS ownership are directly verified.

Does the original five-project portfolio still exist as a single UBS-owned platform through 2026, or has it been reorganized, sold or merged into later portfolios?
